newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude up to $20.83 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude up to $20.83 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude rose to an average of $20.83 per barrel on October 2, up from the $20.80 the day before, a spokesman for state-run Petroecuador said Monday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The price average in September was $20.03 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
